title: Introductory call
details: First call to introduce HackYourFuture and our programme. They are curious about hiring juniors and asked for more information about the specialization tracks.

title: Partnership kick-off
details: Kick-off meeting with HR and an engineering manager. Agreed on a partnership for the coming year and a single point of contact on both sides.

title: Sent partnership proposal
details: Sent the partnership proposal with the placement fee structure and the timeline of the next cohort. They will review it internally.

title: Partnership agreement signed
details: Received the signed partnership agreement. Shared it with the finance team and added the organisation to the active partners list.

title: Follow-up on proposal
details: Followed up on the partnership proposal. They need approval from their management team and expect an answer within two weeks.

title: No response to proposal
details: Sent a reminder about the partnership proposal. No response yet after three weeks, will try once more by phone.

title: Partnership declined
details: They decided not to partner with us this year because of budget constraints. Open to reconnecting next year.

title: Yearly partnership review
details: Reviewed the past year together. Two graduates are still working there and they want to continue the partnership.

title: New contact person
details: Our contact person left the company. They introduced their successor from the talent acquisition team.

title: Introduced the new programme
details: Presented the updated programme structure with the core program and specialization tracks. They liked the focus on cloud and testing.

title: Hiring needs for next quarter
details: Discussed their hiring plans for the next quarter. They expect two junior frontend positions and one data role.

title: Received job descriptions
details: Received job descriptions for two junior developer positions. Shared them with the job preparation team.

title: Internship positions
details: They can offer three paid internships of six months, with the option of a permanent contract afterwards.

title: Hiring freeze
details: They put all hiring on hold until the end of the year due to a reorganisation. Will check in again next quarter.

title: Hiring freeze lifted
details: Good news: the hiring freeze is over and they are looking for junior backend developers again.

title: Question about available graduates
details: They asked on Slack whether we have graduates available with React experience. Shared the upcoming graduation date.

title: Tech stack and required skills
details: Walked through their tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js and AWS. They mostly need strong fundamentals and good communication skills.

title: Dutch language requirement
details: Asked whether their open roles require Dutch. They confirmed English is fine for the development team.

title: Tester role available
details: They have an opening for a junior test automation engineer. Good fit for graduates of the tester track.

title: Cloud traineeship programme
details: They shared details about their own cloud traineeship. Graduates of the cloud track can apply directly.

title: Shared candidate profiles
details: Sent four anonymised candidate profiles matching their junior frontend vacancy. Asked for feedback within a week.

title: Feedback on candidate profiles
details: They want to invite two of the four candidates for a first interview. The other profiles lacked backend experience.

title: Interviews scheduled
details: Scheduled first interviews for two candidates next week. Shared the interview format with the trainees.

title: Interview feedback
details: Positive feedback after the first interview. The candidate showed good problem solving, but should prepare better questions about the company.

title: Technical assignment feedback
details: The candidate completed the take-home assignment well. They noted clean code and good tests, but missing error handling.

title: Candidate not selected
details: They decided not to continue with the candidate. The main reason was limited experience with databases. Shared the feedback with the trainee.

title: Job offer made
details: They made a job offer to one of our graduates for a junior developer role starting next month.

title: Offer accepted
details: The graduate accepted the offer. Asked them to send the contract details for our placement records.

title: Internship offer
details: They offered a six-month internship to one of our graduates. Start date and mentor are already arranged.

title: Second interview round
details: Invited the candidate for a second interview with the team lead, including a pair programming session.

title: Check-in on placed graduate
details: Checked in on the graduate who started last month. They are settling in well and already made their first contributions.

title: Three-month performance feedback
details: Their manager is happy with the progress of our graduate. Next step is taking more ownership of features.

title: Concerns about a graduate
details: The manager raised concerns about the graduate missing deadlines. Agreed to set up a meeting with the graduate and their mentor.

title: Contract extension
details: They extended the contract of our graduate for another year. Very positive about the collaboration.

title: Internship converted to job
details: The intern received a permanent contract after completing the internship. Updated the placement records.

title: Graduate left the company
details: Our graduate left for another job. They were happy with the graduate and are open to new candidates.

title: Buddy programme for new hires
details: Discussed setting up a buddy for our graduates in their first months. They will pair each new hire with a senior developer.

title: Feedback on soft skills
details: The team appreciates the communication skills of our graduate. They suggested more practice with estimating tasks.

title: Probation period passed
details: The graduate passed their probation period. The company thanked us for the good match.

title: Onboarding issues
details: The graduate did not have access to the systems in the first week. They apologised and fixed it quickly.

title: Invoice for placement fee
details: Sent the invoice for the placement fee of the graduate who started last month.

title: Placement fee paid
details: Received the payment of the placement fee. Confirmed receipt and thanked them for the support.

title: Question about the fee structure
details: They asked whether the placement fee also applies to internships. Explained that it only applies to permanent positions.

title: Payment reminder
details: The placement fee invoice is two months overdue. Sent a friendly reminder to their finance department.

title: Sponsorship discussion
details: Discussed a yearly sponsorship to support the programme. They will present it to their board next month.

title: Donation received
details: They made a donation to support the next cohort. Sent a thank-you note and the ANBI details for their records.

title: Laptop donation
details: They will donate ten refurbished laptops for trainees who don't have one. Agreed on a pick-up date.

title: Budget for next year
details: They confirmed their budget for the partnership is approved for next year.

title: Mentors from their team
details: Three of their developers want to volunteer as mentors for the next cohort. Shared the mentor sign-up link.

title: Tech talk proposal
details: They offered to give a tech talk about testing strategies. Proposed two dates in the coming month.

title: Tech talk at Codam
details: Their lead developer gave a talk about microservices at our weekly session. Trainees asked many questions.

title: Workshop on Git workflows
details: Two of their engineers ran a hands-on workshop on branching strategies and code reviews.

title: Mock interviews
details: They offered to run mock technical interviews with trainees in the job preparation phase.

title: Mock interview results
details: Shared feedback from the mock interviews. Most trainees did well on coding, but need to explain their thinking out loud more.

title: Final project demo day
details: Their team joined the final project demo day as guests and gave feedback to the project teams.

title: Final project jury
details: They agreed to be part of the jury for the final project presentations.

title: Code review volunteers
details: They want to help with reviewing trainee assignments. Explained how the review process works.

title: Hosting a weekly session
details: They offered their office as a venue for one of our weekly sessions. Discussed capacity and catering.

title: Guest lecture about data engineering
details: Their data engineer will give a guest lecture for the data track about building data pipelines.

title: Office visit with trainees
details: Visited their office with a group of trainees. They got a tour and met developers from different teams.

title: Career fair
details: Met their recruiters at a career fair in Amsterdam. They were interested in our upcoming graduates.

title: Hackathon partner
details: They co-organised a weekend hackathon with us. Four trainee teams worked on problems from their product.

title: Invitation to graduation
details: Invited them to the graduation ceremony of the current cohort.

title: Networking evening
details: Attended a networking evening at their office. Good chance for graduates to meet hiring managers.

title: Meetup venue
details: They offered to host our alumni meetup next month and will provide food and drinks.

title: Speed dating with graduates
details: Organised short introductions between their hiring managers and eight graduates. Three follow-up interviews planned.

title: Curriculum feedback
details: They suggested adding more attention to writing tests and working with legacy code in the curriculum.

title: Skills gap in cloud
details: They noticed graduates lack experience with infrastructure as code. Shared the feedback with the cloud track team.

title: Suggested learning materials
details: They sent a list of free courses their juniors use for learning Kubernetes.

title: Advice on the tester track
details: Their QA lead gave advice on which tools to teach in the tester track, mainly Playwright and API testing.

title: Diversity and inclusion goals
details: Discussed how partnering with us supports their diversity goals. They want to share the story internally.

title: Data sharing agreement
details: Sent the data sharing agreement for exchanging candidate profiles, in line with GDPR.

title: Signed data sharing agreement
details: Received the signed data sharing agreement. We can now share full candidate profiles with them.

title: Updated company details
details: They moved to a new office. Updated their address and main phone number.

title: Question about trainee background
details: They asked about the work permits of our graduates. Explained that all graduates are allowed to work in the Netherlands.

title: Newsletter feature
details: Asked if we can feature their partnership in our newsletter. They approved the text and a photo.

title: Case study request
details: They want to write a case study about hiring our graduates for their blog. Sent some background information.

title: LinkedIn post about partnership
details: They posted about our partnership on LinkedIn. Shared it from the HackYourFuture account.

title: Quick question about start dates
details: They asked on Slack when the next group of graduates is available. Answered with the expected graduation month.

title: Shared open position
details: They shared a new junior position in our Slack channel for partners. Forwarded it to the job preparation team.

title: Interview time change
details: They asked to move an interview to the afternoon. Confirmed with the candidate and updated the invite.

title: Asked for a reference
details: They asked for a reference for one of our graduates. Connected them with the graduate's mentor.

title: Thank you message
details: They sent a thank-you message after the workshop. The trainees really enjoyed it.

title: Quarterly check-in
details: Quarterly check-in with their HR team. Discussed the progress of current placements and upcoming vacancies.

title: Planning next cohort collaboration
details: Planned how they can be involved in the next cohort, from mentoring to hosting a session and interviewing graduates.

title: Reconnecting after a quiet period
details: Reached out after a year without contact. They are hiring again and want to restart the collaboration.

title: Partnership paused
details: They paused the partnership while their team is restructured. Will reconnect in six months.

title: Complaint about communication
details: They felt our response to their vacancy was too slow. Apologised and agreed on a faster process for sharing profiles.

title: Remote work policy
details: They explained their hybrid work policy. Juniors work at the office three days a week during the first months.

title: Salary range for juniors
details: They shared the salary range for their junior positions, which helps us set expectations with graduates.

title: Part-time position
details: They have a part-time junior role of 24 hours a week. Could fit graduates who combine work with other obligations.

title: Relocation question
details: The position is in Eindhoven. Asked if candidates need to relocate. They offer a travel allowance instead.

title: Introduction to their graduate programme
details: They presented their two-year graduate programme with rotations through different teams.

title: Feedback on HackYourFuture process
details: They were happy with how smooth the hiring process was and the quality of the candidate preparation.

title: Volunteer hours for employees
details: Their employees get volunteer hours they can spend on mentoring our trainees. Shared the possibilities.

title: Introduction to another company
details: They introduced us to a partner company that is also looking for junior developers.

title: Event cancelled
details: The planned office visit is cancelled because of an internal event. Proposed a new date next month.

title: Met at a conference
details: Met one of their engineering managers at a developer conference. Exchanged contact details and planned a call.

title: Referred by an alumnus
details: One of our alumni works there and referred us to their recruitment team.

title: Joined partner advisory board
details: Their CTO joined our partner advisory board and will attend the meetings twice a year.
